reason: The author prerequisite (PLAN_v1.md 2.3, PLAN_v2.md 2.1) was not completed: TiJepa/manual_downloads/ does not exist on the author's Drive and neither Dryad m0cfxpp8v nor LTDB is in the account (checked at the start of the run and again before the evaluations; see results/v2/manual_intake.json). consequences: Part A has NO video benchmark with activation-state labels, so the frame-shuffle control E5 cannot be evaluated on a labelled video task and Part A's classification evidence rests on static BBBC054 morphology classes.
The F3.4 forecasting evaluation runs on S-BIAD2196 only, not on Dryad.
Part C 8.4 (the C3 projection) cannot be performed: it needs image-space M0/M1/M2 centroids with stimuli matched to the omics anchors. See results/v1/partC/c3_projection.json.
The every-2-hour collapse monitor uses a fixed BBBC054 subset instead of Dryad (results/v2/pretrain_monitor.csv).
